description: This file declares the RemoteSharedSecret class, which implements the BnSharedSecret interface for remote shared secret operations in Android's security framework. It includes method declarations for obtaining shared secret parameters and computing shared secrets, and references external keymaster and aidl security components.

classes.name: RemoteSharedSecret
classes.description: Implements shared secret operations for remote keymaster interactions, providing methods to retrieve parameters and compute shared secrets.

methods.name: RemoteSharedSecret
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the RemoteSharedSecret with a reference to a RemoteKeymaster instance.

methods.name: getSharedSecretParameters
methods.description: Retrieves the parameters necessary for shared secret computation.

methods.name: computeSharedSecret
methods.description: Computes the shared secret based on provided parameters.
